about.title: About LLMCompare
about.backgroundDesc: LLM Compare is an AI model selection assistant — showcasing 58 global AI models to help you find the best fit.
about.backgroundMission: Provides scene-based recommendations by 'Hotness' and 'Intelligence'. Detail pages show comprehensive scores, pricing, and recommendation tags. The compare page supports side-by-side multi-model comparison.
about.backgroundContribute: Found an error or want to add a model? Submit via
about.filterDesc: Filtered from Artificial Analysis global models using three criteria: Large size class, frontier status, or intelligence score ≥30 (to include high value smaller models). Outdated model versions are automatically excluded. Active set retains models published within 180 days. Arena rankings and OpenRouter popularity data are integrated, ranked by intelligence score.
about.sourceDesc: Artificial Analysis is a leading LLM evaluation platform providing standardized benchmarks. Its Intelligence Index combines MMLU, HumanEval, MATH and more to assess reasoning, coding, and math capabilities.
about.priceDetail: Official pricing sourced from model vendor websites. Detail pages show both official pricing and OpenRouter pricing. The table uses OpenRouter pricing for consistent comparison. Updated weekly.
about.arenaDesc: lmarena.ai (formerly Chatbot Arena) is the world's largest crowdsourced LLM leaderboard, generating ELO scores from real human blind tests. We collect data from its text, coding, and vision rankings as a third-party reference for real-world usage experience.
about.orDesc: The world's largest LLM API routing platform, providing unified API access and weekly token consumption rankings. We collect its public weekly rankings and API pricing — volume reflects real-world usage, pricing reflects market rates.
about.disclaimerDesc: This field guide is for reference only. Model performance varies by use case and may differ from the data presented.
about.fieldGuideDesc: Key metrics used across the site and what they mean.
about.fieldIntelligence: Intelligence: Artificial Analysis composite index blending MMLU, HumanEval, MATH and more. 0-100 scale.
about.fieldCoding: Coding: Task-specific score for code generation and understanding. 0-100 scale.
about.fieldAgentic: Agentic: Measures multi-step reasoning, tool use and autonomous execution. 0-100 scale.
about.fieldSpeed: Speed: Median TPS, time-to-first-token and end-to-end latency from standardized benchmarks.
about.fieldPricing: Pricing: Blended price = input×75% + output×25%; table defaults to OpenRouter pricing for fair comparison.
about.fieldArena: Arena: lmarena.ai ELO scores and vote counts from human blind tests, reflecting real-world experience.
about.fieldCompleteness: Data Completeness: Weighted score over 18 core fields; closer to 100% means more complete data.
about.criteriaDesc: To keep the leaderboard practical and comparable, models are included based on:
about.criteriaSize: Size threshold: Large-size, frontier, or intelligence ≥30 high-value models from Artificial Analysis.
about.criteriaFresh: Freshness threshold: Active set keeps models published within the last 180 days; older variants are retired.
about.criteriaUnique: Deduplication: Only the highest-intelligence variant is kept within each series sub-group.
about.coverageDesc: Coverage of each data source across included models in the latest refresh:
about.coverageNote: Coverage = models with data from this source / total included models. Newer or closed-source models may lack Arena/OpenRouter data temporarily.
about.changelogEmpty: No significant changes in this refresh.

product.benchmarkSubtitle: Detailed benchmark scores covering multiple evaluation dimensions
product.dataCompletenessDesc: Weighted completeness score based on 18 core fields including benchmarks, speed, pricing, and Arena rankings
product.dataCompletionDesc: The following fields are not yet available: {fields}. Contributions with sources are welcome.

tip.intelligence: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index — combines MMLU, HumanEval, MATH and more to assess reasoning, coding, and math. 0-100, higher is better.
tip.coding: Artificial Analysis Coding score — based on code generation and understanding tasks. 0-100, higher is better.
tip.agentic: Artificial Analysis Agentic score — evaluates tool use, multi-step reasoning, and task completion. 0-100, higher is better.
tip.gpqa: Graduate-Level Google-Proof Q&A benchmark — tests high-difficulty science questions. 0-100, higher is better.
tip.hle: Humanity's Last Exam benchmark — tests extreme reasoning capabilities. 0-100, higher is better.
tip.speed: Tokens Per Second — how many tokens the model processes per second. Higher is faster.
tip.p5: P5 speed — the processing speed of the fastest 5% of samples, reflecting peak performance.
tip.p95: P95 speed — the processing speed of the slowest 5% of samples, reflecting worst-case performance.
tip.ttft: Time to First Token — delay from sending a request to receiving the first token. Lower is better.
tip.e2e: End-to-End Latency — total time to complete a full request. Lower is better.
tip.blended: Weighted average of input and output pricing, calculated at a typical 60% input / 40% output ratio.
tip.inputPrice: Input price — cost per million input tokens. Lower is cheaper.
tip.outputPrice: Output price — cost per million output tokens. Lower is cheaper.
tip.parameters: Number of model parameters (B = Billion). Generally larger models are more capable but cost more to run.
tip.orWeeklyTokens: Real weekly token consumption on OpenRouter, reflecting real-world usage popularity.
tip.arenaVotes: Cumulative blind human evaluation votes from lmarena.ai (Chatbot Arena). More votes = more reliable ranking.
tip.elo: ELO rating from paired battle results on lmarena.ai. Typical range 1200-1600, higher ranks higher.
tip.contextWindow: Maximum number of tokens the model can process in a single request (input + output combined). Larger = can handle longer content.
tip.knowledgeCutoff: The date up to which the model's training data includes world knowledge. Events after this date may not be known.
